name: Lordling of Hearts
storyline: One strange day, you wake up in the body of Genevave Draakenburcht van de Hogentoren, the greatest fool of a lordling who ever lived. Your spymaster has usurped your throne, the people despise you for Genevave's actions, your house seeks to finish their botched assassination attempt, and worst of all, Genevave's mind is in your head with you, and refuses to shut up. Either you will get the subjects of the Draakenburcht on your side, or you will suffer a painful end. Capture their hearts, or die trying.
summary: Lordling of hearts is an erotic fantasy text-RPG, made to have a "deeply interwoven mechanics, an endearing cast, and a cozy comedy plot!"
